simple.meaning: אוּל (ʼûwl) is a Hebrew word meaning “the body (as being rolled together); also powerful.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אוּל (H193) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Kings 24:15, with occurrences in 2 Kings, Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אוּל (H193) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אוּל (H193) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אוּל (ʼûwl) / H193 is traced through 2 Kings 24:15, Psalms 73:4 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: the body (as being rolled together); also powerful
definitions.full: H193. uwl I. [ אוּל ] noun [masculine] body, belly; suffix אוּלָם (in contempt) Psa 73:4 (literally their front, prominent part ). II. [ אוּל ] noun [masculine] leading man, noble; plural construct הָאָרֶץ אוּלֵי 2Kin 24:15 Kt (Qr אֵילֵי see [III. איל ]).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to twist, i.e. (by implication) be strong;
